title: Freemasonry descends from cathedral-builder guilds and the Templars

tellings.quote: uh traditions that sort of merged together that that became the basis for modern firming. One being the guild uh this the lodge system of guild builders that actually built the cathedrals and the Templar knights.

plain: Modern Freemasonry, the secretive brotherhood organised in lodges, grew out of two older traditions that merged, according to the researcher Randall Carlson: the lodges of the guild builders who put up Europe's cathedrals, and the Knights Templar, a medieval order of warrior monks. Carlson gives this as his own summary, without naming a source. It matters to him because it would link the Masons to old building knowledge and to the Templars' secrets.
